title: Design a Payment Gateway
description: Model payments, multiple payment methods, and transaction states.

data.text: Design a payment gateway like Razorpay or Stripe. Support multiple payment methods (card, UPI, net banking), payment states, and webhook notifications.

data.title: Payment and PaymentMethod
Why separate Authorize and Capture?
data.text: Authorize reserves money without transferring it. Capture completes the transfer. This lets you authorize at checkout and capture only when the order ships, enabling refunds without money movement.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Payment is a state machine with Pending -> Authorized -> Captured
PaymentMethod enum makes adding new methods trivial
Webhooks notify merchants of status changes
data.takeaway: Payment gateways are state machines with strict money rules. Separate authorization from capture to minimize refund risk and enable delayed settlements.
